summary: Tested the new Company Detail screen architecture end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_company_crud.py — GET /api/companies shape ({items, active_id}), POST creates doc with id/user_id/name/no _id, PUT persists every CompanyIn field, partial updates work, POST link-account sets and clears (null/empty), POST activate sets active_id + 404 on unknown, DELETE shifts active_id to next created company, POST /api/company/autofill returns offerings/value_props/industry/target_audience populated. Frontend: signed up a fresh random user, opened Settings tab, empty state 'No companies yet' renders with add-company-btn, inline form (new-company-name-input/save/cancel) appears on tap, creating 'Acme Inc' navigates to /company/{id}, ALL 13 detail-page testIDs present (company-back, company-name-input, company-website-input, company-autofill, company-offerings-input, company-value-props-input, company-target-input, company-delete, company-industry-SaaS, company-industry-FinTech, company-linkedin-connect, company-facebook-connect, company-instagram-connect). Autofill with linear.app website returned '✓ Auto-filled from site' toast in ~10s and populated 384 chars of offerings. confirm-delete/confirm-cancel modal works. After creating 'Beta Corp' second company, ACTIVE badge correctly moved to Beta card in Settings. After re-activating Acme via company-set-active button and returning, set-active toast fired correctly. ZERO React pageerror, ZERO red screen. One real bug found: Settings tab doesn't refresh after a company is deleted on the detail screen — deleted card stays visible until app reload (root cause: settings.tsx only uses useEffect, not useFocusEffect, and it's a persistent tab screen).

ui_bugs.issue: Stale state after delete: when a company is deleted on /company/[id] detail page via confirm-delete and router.back() returns to /settings, the deleted card REMAINS visible in the Settings list because settings.tsx's loadCompanies() only runs on mount (useEffect), not on screen focus. Tabs in Expo Router are persistent → never unmount → useEffect never re-fires. Verified: Acme was deleted server-side (URL went to /settings, backend DELETE 200) but the company-card-{acmeId} element was still present on settings after router.back. Fix: wrap loadCompanies in useFocusEffect from expo-router OR in remove() inside /company/[id].tsx, pass a `refresh=1` param or use router.replace('/(tabs)/settings') with a state-bumping mechanism. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:122 (useEffect-only) and /app/frontend/app/company/[id].tsx:116-128 (remove() just calls router.back).

rca_of_issue: Bug: After deleting a company on /company/[id] and returning to Settings, the deleted card persists in the UI. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx uses `useEffect(() => { load(); loadCompanies(); }, [load, loadCompanies])` which runs once at mount. Settings is a tab screen wrapped in expo-router Tabs → its component instance is preserved across navigations → useEffect's dependencies never change → loadCompanies() never re-fires. /app/frontend/app/company/[id].tsx's remove() does `await api.deleteCompany(...); router.back()` — no shared state, no event bus, no useFocusEffect on the Settings side. Reproduction: 1) sign up fresh user, 2) Settings → Add company 'X' → in detail tap delete → confirm-delete, 3) URL returns to /settings, 4) company-card-{X.id} element STILL renders. Mitigation: import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router'; useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { loadCompanies(); }, [loadCompanies]));  — this is a 2-line fix. Same fix incidentally also covers stale state for in-detail field edits (name/website/etc.) which also won't reflect in the card meta line until app reload.
